boxes.title: Ajanta & painting: more
items: Ajanta: called ==India's first UNESCO site==; found **1819** by **John Smith**
Ajanta: **Jataka** paintings; cave-painting + rock-cut monasteries in a cliff
Sculpture moved from ==**rigid**== to graceful forms

items: **Vishnukundins** ==started Hindu cave temples in Telugu lands==, imitating Pallava style
